data.narrative:
Stratum AI is a Seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Daniel Mogilny and Farzi Yusufali that has raised $400K to date. The target operates within a frontier climate and energy sector comprising one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

Valuation analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, as peer-median triangulation is not applicable. The Climate & Energy sector contains eight companies, but none satisfy tight filters for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier comparability—the minimum threshold of three datapoints was not met. The stage-progression method applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier to the $400K total raised proxy, treating this as a base valuation benchmark and applying typical Seed-to-next-stage advancement assumptions. This method implies a valuation of $1.0M.

Given the single applicable method and absence of peer-derived validation, the triangulated range is $850K–$1.15M, with a median of $1.0M. This reflects the mathematical output of stage-progression rather than corroboration across multiple approaches. Key uncertainties include capital intensity of the technology, pathway to Series A financing, and whether the narrow peer set will prove relevant as the company progresses. Additional methodologies (customer traction, TAM-based approaches) would require operational metrics not provided in the dataset.
